standards.name: Manufacturer reference: Schluter-JOLLY profile
standards.description: Wall tile edge / outside-corner protection profile, 90 degree angle, heights 3-12.5 mm (1/8-1/2 in), standard length 2.5 m (8 ft 2-1/2 in); materials incl. anodized & colour-coated aluminium, chrome-plated solid brass, stainless steel. Not a regulatory standard - a manufacturer spec used as a reference.

standards.name: Manufacturer reference: Schluter-SCHIENE profile
standards.description: L-angle edging profile, 87 degree angle; aluminium heights from 3/32 in (~2.4 mm) to 1 in (25.4 mm); integrated joint spacer in sizes above 1/4 in (6 mm). Manufacturer spec, not a regulatory standard.

Jolly.canonical_term: Rounded/bevelled tile edge trim (Profile Shape: Round Edge)

Quadec.canonical_term: Square-edge tile finishing/corner profile (Profile Shape: Square Edge)

Schiene.canonical_term: L-angle tile edging profile (Profile Shape: L-Shape)
